TRAIN_statistics.definition: Square root of equal-system mean per-coordinate second moment of future minus last observation, using six TRAIN visits/system covering histories and native clocks
TRAIN_statistics.limitation: Per-coordinate moment approximation only; individual atom tails are not uniformly negligible, and high-dimensional distribution closeness is unproven. No validation-derived scales.
TRAIN_statistics.failed_first_attempt: AttributeError reading nonexistent ClipBatch.atoms before scoring first record; repaired to x.shape[1]. Failed directory/log retained; only v2 completed statistics define both recipes.

A.loss: Equal-system valid atom/frame coordinate MSE(u,Y-R)/sigma_data^2; the common constant normalization does not change the target or optimum
A.sampling: Deterministic rectified-flow ODE from independently drawn R over s0->1, Heun with last Euler. No Brownian bridge, stochastic bridge matching, extra SDE noise, projection or displacement clipping.

B.training: deltaY=Y-X_ref; sigma log-uniform over frozen TRAIN bounds; Z=deltaY+sigma*epsilon
B.c_in: 1/sqrt(sigma^2+sigma_data^2), applied to the displacement stem, while geometry receives current physical XYZ
B.output: D=c_skip*Z+c_out*F_theta; clean displacement, not next noisy state
B.sampling: Z=sigma_max*epsilon; power7 EDM grid sigma_max->sigma_min->0; ODE direction(Z-D)/sigma; Heun at positive endpoints; final zero-noise endpoint assigned D directly; no sigma0 network call, churn or guidance
B.not_claimed: This is EDM-style molecular displacement modeling, not AF3 reproduction or a claim that diffusion must outperform flow.
